cpi.label: CPI
cpi.riskWarning: Market may initially spike in both directions before choosing a trend. Avoid entering during the first seconds after release.

core-cpi.label: Core CPI
core-cpi.riskWarning: Core CPI can reverse the initial headline reaction. Wait for the first minute of price discovery before committing size.

ppi.label: PPI
ppi.riskWarning: PPI often moves markets briefly before CPI weeks. Liquidity can be thinner — size positions carefully.

core-ppi.label: Core PPI
core-ppi.riskWarning: Core PPI surprises can fade quickly if CPI expectations are already priced. Avoid chasing the first tick.

nfp.label: NFP
nfp.riskWarning: NFP frequently whipsaws in the first 30–60 seconds. Unemployment and wage components can contradict the headline.

unemployment-rate.label: Unemployment Rate
unemployment-rate.riskWarning: Unemployment is inverse to typical growth prints. Confirm you are trading the correct direction before entry.

interest-rate-decision.label: Interest Rate Decision
interest-rate-decision.riskWarning: The statement and press conference often matter more than the rate itself. Expect volatility through the full event window.

fomc-statement.label: FOMC
fomc-statement.riskWarning: FOMC reactions can reverse on the press conference. Scale in only after the initial spike settles.

ism-manufacturing-pmi.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI
ism-manufacturing-pmi.riskWarning: ISM can gap through the 50 line and reverse if prices or employment sub-indexes disagree with the headline.

ism-services-pmi.label: ISM Services PMI
ism-services-pmi.riskWarning: Services PMI moves can be short-lived around other major data. Avoid oversized entries at the print.

gdp.label: GDP
gdp.riskWarning: Advance GDP is often revised. The initial reaction may not hold into the final estimate.

retail-sales.label: Retail Sales
retail-sales.riskWarning: Retail Sales ex-auto can diverge from the headline. Watch for a second leg after the control group is digested.

core-pce.label: Core PCE
core-pce.riskWarning: Core PCE is the Fed’s preferred gauge — reactions can persist. Still avoid the first seconds of the spike.
